papers.version: arXiv:2404.06654v3 [cs.CL], 6 Aug 2024; Published as a conference paper at COLM 2024
papers.authority: Original benchmark paper by Hsieh, Sun, Kriman, Acharya, Rekesh, Jia, Zhang, and Ginsburg; NVIDIA affiliation verified on original first page.
papers.inspected_original: First-page identity; abstract; section 3 introduction and sections 3.1–3.4 including Table 2; section 4 Models & Inference setup and Task configurations. Searches also exposed unrelated official-paper result snippets; no repository author summary was used.
papers.support_scope: Single, multi-values, multi-queries retrieval; multi-hop tracing; aggregation; QA; answer-presence recall is not a no-extras/order criterion. No published model score is used as a course-model result.

papers.authority: Original paper by Liu, Lin, Hewitt, Paranjape, Bevilacqua, Petroni, and Liang; original author affiliations verified on first page.
papers.inspected_original: First-page identity and abstract; section 2 and section 2.1 complete setup paragraphs, including annotated-answer selection and ambiguity footnote; section 2.2 decoding paragraph; section 3.1 synthetic key-value setup.
papers.support_scope: Controlled multi-document QA selects one document with a NaturalQuestions annotated answer; distractors exclude annotated answers. Ambiguous reasonable alternatives can exist as stated in footnote 2. It does not test obligatory cross-document combination. Position and length are distinct controlled factors; inference uses greedy decoding.

papers.authority: Original paper by Bai and coauthors; Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI, and Institute of Automation affiliations verified on original first page.
papers.inspected_original: First-page identity and abstract; section 3.1 input/context/answer definition; section 3.2.1 multi-document QA and summarization paragraphs, including continuation on original PDF page 4.
papers.support_scope: Includes multi-hop datasets HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and summarization datasets GovReport, QMSum, MultiNews, VCSUM. Not every task in this benchmark is a multi-hop task; no version-conflict benchmark claim is inferred.
papers.snapshot_format: Raw UTF-8 slices from pdftotext -layout output of the original versioned PDF, concatenated without Unicode or newline normalization; not an author summary.
papers.compact_pdf_disposition: Original-PDF pages 1,3,4 were initially exported, but inherited large unneeded shared resources. The 11.7 MB export was removed after preserving and byte-verifying inspected original text slices.
